title: 1.2 Website Design
description: Purpose and guidelines of website design

questions.question: Website design is concerned with the plan and design of which of the following aspects of a website?
What is the goal of website design?
options: To create a website that is appealing to its target audience and makes finding information easy with a well-organized presentation
To make a website difficult for visitors to understand
To include as many graphics as possible on every page
To hide information from the target audience
questions.correctAnswer: To create a website that is appealing to its target audience and makes finding information easy with a well-organized presentation

questions.question: Which of the following lists the guidelines for good website design?
options: Target Audience, Navigation, Consistency, Simplicity, and Accessibility
Target Audience, Navigation, Encryption, Hosting, and Security
Navigation, Consistency, Bandwidth, Storage, and Security
Accessibility, Simplicity, Servers, Protocols, and Databases
questions.correctAnswer: Target Audience, Navigation, Consistency, Simplicity, and Accessibility

questions.question: Which website design guideline states that a website should be designed with its intended users in mind?
Which website design guideline states that webpages should be logically organized to allow easy movement between them?
Which website design guideline states that the feel and look of webpages on a website should be similar?
Which website design guideline deals with limiting colors and using graphics only when required?
Which website design guideline involves designing with everyone in mind, including people with disabilities?
A website intended for children in educational settings having a different presentation from one designed for adults in a business environment illustrates which guideline?
According to the textbook, what does poor navigation on a website do?
options: It confuses and drives away visitors
It helps users find information fast
questions.correctAnswer: It confuses and drives away visitors

questions.question: The WHO website is used in the textbook as an example of which guideline?
What is achieved by the consistent use of backgrounds, colors, and typefaces throughout a website?
According to the Simplicity guideline, a maximum of how many different colors is recommended for a better user experience?
Website design deals with which of the following?
options: Defining the layout and overall look of the website
The actual creation or building of websites
questions.correctAnswer: Defining the layout and overall look of the website

questions.question: Web development is best described as which of the following?
options: The actual creation or building of websites
Defining the layout and overall look of a website
Deciding the target audience of a website
Choosing the colors used on a website
questions.correctAnswer: The actual creation or building of websites

questions.question: WYSIWYG software such as Adobe Dreamweaver is used for which of the following?
According to the textbook, developing webpages using simple text editors such as Notepad is which of the following compared with WYSIWYG software?
options: A little more difficult but more effective for mastering the language
Easier but less effective for mastering the language
Faster but less effective for mastering the language
questions.correctAnswer: A little more difficult but more effective for mastering the language

questions.question: True or False: Website design and web development mean the same thing.
True or False: The goal of website design includes making the search for information easy through a well-organized presentation.
True or False: According to the Simplicity guideline, it is recommended to overcrowd a page with as many graphics as possible.
True or False: Accessibility in website design means designing with everyone in mind, including people with disabilities.
True or False: Consistent use of backgrounds, colors, and typefaces throughout a website improves the user experience.
